title: Taurus, you are not behind
old_caption: Everyone's getting engaged and you feel late? There's no deadline on love, and their timeline isn't your scoreboard. Build a life you love in the meantime.

title: Virgo, take your own advice
old_caption: You'd never let your best friend settle, so don't let yourself. Talk to you the way you talk to them. Tag the friend who gives advice and never takes it.

title: Gemini, you deserve a definitely
old_caption: Stuck on 'we'll see'? That isn't an answer. Ask once, clearly, then believe what they tell you. You're allowed to want something sure.

title: The full pep talk: the 2 a.m. breakup call
old_caption: The 2 a.m. call after a breakup, start to finish. Breaking up isn't failing; it's two people being honest. Stay for the last line, and send it to whoever needs it tonight.

title: The full pep talk: your crush said no
old_caption: They said no, and the replay won't stop. A no to dating isn't a no to you, and the proof of who you are doesn't depend on one answer. The last line, though.

title: The full pep talk: home alone for the holidays
old_caption: Alone on the 24th and telling everyone you're fine? Lonely isn't a flaw; it's a signal to reach for your people. Someone has a seat saved for you.

title: The full pep talk: you got ghosted
old_caption: Three days of grey ticks after a great date. Their silence is about their skills, not your worth. One kind closing text, then phone down. You can make your own closure.

title: The full pep talk: scared to try again
old_caption: Someone nice asked you out and every old hurt showed up first. The new person isn't the old one. Not forever, just one coffee. Wait for the last line.

title: Dating or just hanging out?
old_caption:
Movie night number nine, shared fries, they've met your plant. If you're guessing what this is, that's your sign you're allowed to ask.
Save this for the next couch night.

title: Introduced as "my friend"
old_caption: Being introduced as "my friend" can sting when you hoped for more. That sting is information. Tell them how it landed, then ask what they meant.
